headline: Seattle Pacific take seven wins into conference play
dek: Seattle Pacific won at Saint Edward's on Friday, their seventh win against a single defeat, and have more wins than any other programme in the conference. Western Washington made the same two visits in the opposite order and lost at Dallas Baptist.
displaced_by: The standing dek's 'sixth win' is no longer true: Seattle Pacific won at Saint Edward's for a seventh.
